status: in-progress; non-M5 source parity is not complete

remainingNonM5.scope: Every candidate reached through a national spawn-point deck is recruited, or excluded with its source reason in roster-expansion.json (unreachable easter eggs, air-combat mode, capture points/FOBs, platoon preload flags, trench attachments, paid SUP launches). TOS-1A deploy forms and barrage are implemented.
Deploy Smoke and Engine Smoke actions, gates, shared/self cooldowns, smokeG 5 s markers with ATGM interception, life-999 flight variant, cloud and sounds.

Source DynamicLoS (tem/tank.key) target-switch nudges for idle units and its LoS line decal; forest markers from 林区.ini are map content under review against M5. Firing is not gated by it in any recruited unit.

Strike-target/route/landing workflows for sandbox and purchased bomb/missile loadouts (Q-5L, JH-7A, Su-25T, Su-34, F-1, Tornado, Rafale, JAS 39E, F-15E). Ground-attack stores stay omitted; air-to-air and cannon armament are live. Paid rearm requires M5 currencies.
Squads, trench forms, HJ-8 team and BREM/96 recovery implemented and tested; full source search/retry/neutral behaviour and amphibious towing edge cases unaudited.
Fixed-wing controls and FPV sliding movement are source-exact; ordinary ground acceleration, reverse, formation and collision remain native.
Unported conditional art, artillery warning markers, the T-90M Arena-M global announcement, the flying smoke-round sprite and BMP-2M firing cue (gain 5 exceeds the host 0..4 range).
English/Chinese/Korean for every exposed unit, action, stock, deployment and status label; untranslated source resource names now fail the build.

excludedM5: source match/deck mode, SUP/SPP, phases, platoon call-ins, score victory
5v5 TMX scenarios and matching full-spectrum soundtrack
paid loadout/service purchases remain disabled where they require those currencies
